name: NavAppModuleInfo Dep
brief: Dependency half of the per-module NavApp.GetCurrentModuleInfo reproducer: exposes its OWN module identity, which must be this app's (25.8.43.0), never the consuming bundle's.
description: RED before the fix: the runner's GetCurrentModuleInfo polyfill returned the bundle-global app info, so a dependency asking for its own version saw the consuming bundle's 1.0.0.0 — the exact wall SPBLIC's CheckSupportedVersion hit during Pageworks install ('update Pageworks to at least version 25.8.43.0'). GREEN after: each emitted assembly resolves its own registered module identity; GetCallerModuleInfo resolves the nearest foreign AL frame.
